# PlumberWebDesign.co.uk

> Specialist web design and local SEO agency for UK plumbers, gas engineers, heating engineers, and bathroom fitters. Mobile-first, SEO-optimised websites built to rank on Google and generate calls. Transparent monthly pricing from £99/month with no setup fees on website packages. Based in Andover, Hampshire; serving clients UK-wide.

## Key Facts

- Business name: PlumberWebDesign.co.uk
- Founder / lead author: Andrew Norman ([author page](https://www.plumberwebdesign.co.uk/about/andrew-norman/))

- Email: hello@plumberwebdesign.co.uk
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:30 UK
- Market served: United Kingdom only
- Specialisms: Plumber websites, gas engineer websites, heating engineer websites, bathroom fitter websites, local SEO for trades, AI chatbots, AI voice agents
- Minimum term: 6 months from launch; ownership transfers to client after minimum term
- Cancellation: 30 days written notice after the 6-month minimum
- Setup fees: None on website packages; one-off setup fee on AI add-ons only

## Pricing

Three transparent monthly packages (GBP, inclusive of hosting, SSL, and domain):

- **Apprentice — £99/month.** 5-page responsive website. Mobile-optimised. Free domain (if needed). Fast hosting + SSL. Basic local SEO setup. Contact forms. Google Analytics + Search Console. Google Business Profile setup.
- **Journeyman — £169/month (most popular).** 10-page custom website with service and location pages. Advanced local SEO. Hosting + SSL + domain included. Google Business Profile management with monthly posts. Google Review management.
- **Master — £249/month.** 20+ page custom website. Advanced local SEO. Hosting + SSL + domain included. 2 monthly blog posts. Full Google Business Profile optimisation and monthly posting. Optional link building service.

AI add-ons (combine with any package):

- **AI Chatbot — from £49/month + £299 one-off setup.** 24/7 website chatbot that qualifies leads and captures contact details.
- **AI Voice Agent — from £97/month + £497 one-off setup.** UK-voiced AI receptionist that answers inbound calls, qualifies jobs, and books appointments.

## Why UK plumbers choose a specialist agency

- Trade-specific websites that rank for "plumber near me", "boiler repair [city]", and "emergency plumber [city]" searches.
- Gas Safe registration display, emergency booking buttons, click-to-call on every page.
- Local SEO baked in: JSON-LD schema, postcode-specific landing pages, Google Business Profile integration.
- UK-only agency; no black-hat tactics, no overseas labour.
- Transparent monthly pricing with no setup fees on website packages — rare in the UK plumber website market.

## Common Questions (Quick Answers)

- **How much does a plumber website cost in the UK?** £99–£249 per month on a managed plan, or £1,500–£5,000+ as a one-off custom build. Monthly plans include hosting, SSL, and local SEO; one-off builds typically do not.
- **Do plumbers need a website in 2026?** Yes. Over 70% of plumbing searches happen on mobile. A Google Business Profile alone cannot rank for service-specific or location-specific queries.
- **How long does it take to build?** 2–3 weeks from sign-off.
- **Do I own the website?** Yes, after a minimum six-month subscription. Fully transferable with no lock-in after the minimum term.
- **How long until I rank on Google?** 3–6 months for neighbourhood rankings, 9–18 months for competitive city-wide terms. Faster in smaller markets like Andover or Portsmouth.
- **Is local SEO included?** Yes, in every package. Journeyman and Master add ongoing GBP management and content.
- **Can I cancel?** Yes, with 30 days written notice after the six-month minimum.
